roles.name: Editor Settings
roles.purpose: The basic formatting conventions (indentation, charset, line endings) are written down once, for every editor.

roles.name: Continuous Integration
roles.purpose: A pipeline that runs the quality jobs on every change.

roles.name: Package Management
roles.purpose: Dependencies are declared and installed by a package manager.

roles.name: Autoloading
roles.purpose: Classes are found by a convention, not by hand-written includes.

roles.name: Code Style
roles.purpose: An automatic fixer keeps the code in one style, so later automated rewrites land styled.

roles.name: Testing
roles.purpose: A test suite that runs locally and catches regressions.

roles.name: Test Coverage
roles.purpose: The share of the code the tests reach is measured and may not fall.

roles.name: Static Analysis
roles.purpose: A tool reads the code without running it and reports defects, at a level of strictness the project raises step by step.

roles.name: Taint Analysis
roles.purpose: A tool follows data from untrusted input to dangerous operations.

roles.name: Automated Refactoring
roles.purpose: Rule sets rewrite code mechanically, one reviewable set at a time.

roles.name: Code Smell Detection
roles.purpose: A tool measures complexity and flags code that is hard to read.

roles.name: Secret Scanning
roles.purpose: Committed secrets and credentials are found before they ship.

roles.name: Static Security Analysis
roles.purpose: A rule-based scanner looks for common vulnerability patterns in the source.
